metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels in Hong Kong decrease during February 10-25, 2020 compared to January 1-20, 2020?

data.exec_msg:
Image count (Jan 1-20): 268
Image count (Feb 10-25): 210
Jan Mean NO2 (umol/m^2): 138.28
Feb Mean NO2 (umol/m^2): 131.09
Pixel count (Jan/Feb): 174/43
Evidence: Mean NO2 level in February was lower than in January.
A
